sales_opportunities_open_terminal_fields.name: sales_opportunities_open_terminal_fields_check
sales_opportunities_open_terminal_fields.value: "sales_opportunities"."state" <> 'open' or ("sales_opportunities"."closed_at" is null and "sales_opportunities"."final_value_minor" is null and "sales_opportunities"."lost_reason_id" is null)

sales_opportunities_won_fields_check.name: sales_opportunities_won_fields_check
sales_opportunities_won_fields_check.value: "sales_opportunities"."state" <> 'won' or ("sales_opportunities"."closed_at" is not null and "sales_opportunities"."lost_reason_id" is null)

sales_opportunities_lost_fields_check.name: sales_opportunities_lost_fields_check
sales_opportunities_lost_fields_check.value: "sales_opportunities"."state" <> 'lost' or ("sales_opportunities"."closed_at" is not null and "sales_opportunities"."lost_reason_id" is not null)

sla_instances_terminal_fields_check.name: sla_instances_terminal_fields_check
